|lore=To Imperial command personnel: The Rebellion must be crushed! Minor acts of sedition are to be ignored. The destruction of the Alliance is your primary goal.
|game_text=Deploy on table. While you occupy X battlegrounds, whenever you are about to lose Force (except from Force drains at a battleground, battle damage, or your card) you may reduce that loss by X to a minimum of 1 (may not be further reduced). At the beginning of your turn, you may lose 1 Force to activate based on opponent's Force icons rather than your own. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The remaster excludes Force drains generally, whereas the first surviving wording excludes Force drains at a battleground. It drops the express bar on further reduction. Both retain the occupied-battleground amount and minimum of 1, the initial 1-Force loss option and activation on the opposing icons.
